_metadata.description: Declarative budgets with suite-run gating, additive SQLite trend storage, and deterministic fleet offender intelligence.

requirements.title: Declarative budgets with ratchet
requirements.description: A per-scenario and per-flow budget model (build time, bundle size, LCP, component-commit, frame health, browser-work, long-task, and input-event budgets) with a ratchet; budget view/edit is exposed and a breach is computed as a regression.

validation.notes: Budget load/edit round-trip; breach detection per dimension; ratchet tightening behavior.

requirements.title: Suite-run performance gating
requirements.description: A perf regression vs. budget/trend fails the test-genie Performance phase and therefore the suite run (`vrooli scenario test` exit 1).

validation.notes: A regression produces Performance-phase ERROR findings and a failing suite-run verdict; a within-budget run is clean.

requirements.title: Additive SQLite trend storage
requirements.description: A SQLite trend seam (schema.sql, modeled on structure-health's perf store and test-genie self-health snapshots) persists per-run measurements additively (never destructive); trend reads newest-first, scoped per scenario.

validation.notes: Store round-trip, newest-first scoping, and non-destructive append across runs.

requirements.title: Deterministic fleet offender queries
requirements.description: fleet rolls up deterministic structured offender queries (no perf budget, slowest builds, recent regressions, tier distribution) — NOT a search-hub semantic provider; a failing scenario is recorded and the scan continues.

validation.notes: Scan aggregates offenders and tier distribution; a failing scenario is recorded and the scan continues over the rest.
